proof.note: Read from Rohail's public Upwork profile. Jobs are contracts, not clients.

packages.name: Stack Check
packages.for: Solo to 20-person businesses choosing or untangling their CRM, email, funnel and automation tools, or paying for tools that overlap.
deliverables: 45-minute call about how the business runs today
Review of every tool you pay for, and what each one costs
Written report: keep, cut or switch, tool by tool
Monthly cost now against the proposed stack, using this site's dated pricing records
The three fixes worth doing first, ranked by effort and payoff
A 30-day plan
packages.terms: Credited in full against any build booked within 30 days.
packages.honesty: If nothing needs to change, or a free plan will do, the report says so.

packages.name: Automation Build
packages.for: Teams retyping the same data between two to four tools: forms into the CRM, orders into a sheet, invoices into accounting.
deliverables: One end-to-end workflow, built in your own account
Duplicate checks, error handling, retries and failure alerts
A test log run with real records
Written documentation and a short video walkthrough
30 days of fixes
packages.terms: Extra workflows are quoted after the call.
packages.honesty: If the tool you already pay for has a built-in automation that covers it, you will hear that first.

packages.name: CRM Setup and Migration
packages.kind: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, GoHighLevel and others
packages.for: Businesses moving off spreadsheets, or from one CRM to another.
deliverables: Pipeline, stages and custom fields
Import and clean-up of contacts from one source (up to 10,000)
Web form, email and calendar connected
Three to five automations: lead routing, follow-ups, reminders
One dashboard, and user accounts set up
One hour of training, recorded
30 days of support
packages.terms: Extra data sources, integrations or several teams are quoted after the call.
packages.honesty: Only need a basic GoHighLevel account set up? HighLevel offers new accounts its own done-for-you setup for $299 one-time (as of 6 October 2026). Use that.

packages.name: AI Website Assistant
packages.kind: A chat assistant that answers from your own documents
packages.for: Local and service businesses whose inbox fills with the same questions about prices, policies and booking.
deliverables: Assistant trained on your site pages and documents
Answers limited to those sources, with rules for handing off to a person
Leads captured into your CRM, plus your booking link
Hand-off to a person by email or text message
A 30-question test set, with the results
Built in a platform account you own
packages.terms: The chat platform's own monthly fee is separate and paid by you.
packages.honesty: If an off-the-shelf chat tool covers your questions on its own, you will hear that on the call.

packages.name: AI Voice Receptionist
packages.kind: Answers calls, books appointments, sends summaries
packages.for: Trades, salons, repair shops and other appointment businesses that miss calls while they work. Not for practices handling health records.
deliverables: Voice agent in an account you own, on a new number or call forwarding
Call script and a knowledge base of your answers
Bookings into your calendar or CRM, with text confirmations
Call summaries to email or your CRM
Transfer and escalation rules
A set of test calls, and 30 days of tuning
packages.terms: Call minutes and the phone number are billed by the voice platform to you.
packages.honesty: If a ready-made AI receptionist covers your calls for a monthly fee, you will hear that on the call.

care.name: Keep it running
care.what: Monitoring, fixes and small changes to what was built. Optional, and you can stop it any month.
